theme: 测试质量：pytest coverage、Jest 与 Playwright

project_flows.structure: src-layout Python package with src/_pytest, testing, pyproject.toml and coverage annotations
project_flows.focus: pytest fixtures, missing-line coverage, parametrization, flaky failure isolation and quality gates

project_flows.structure: Yarn monorepo with packages/jest-runtime, packages/expect, e2e fixtures and snapshot tests
project_flows.focus: unit isolation, mock ownership, async assertions, snapshots, build failures and coverage evidence

project_flows.structure: Node workspace with packages/playwright, packages/playwright-core, tests/playwright-test and browser fixtures
project_flows.focus: browser exploration, locator discovery, generated E2E tests, accessibility checks and trace-backed failures

project_flows.structure: Gradle multi-module Java project with spring-boot-project, test slices, integration tests and buildSrc
project_flows.focus: test-slice choice, meaningful coverage, deterministic build-failure triage and CI evidence

response_fixture.body: Before accepting a snapshot update, rerun the isolated failure with the original serializer and with fake timers reset, attach a focused received-versus-expected diff, and classify the change as behavior, serializer, or fixture drift. Only an approved behavior change may update the snapshot; serializer or fixture drift must be fixed at its source.

skills.name: pytest-coverage
skills.use_when: A Python pytest suite needs an annotated coverage report and tests for specific missing lines.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is JavaScript unit testing, browser E2E, or only a build configuration failure.

skills.name: javascript-typescript-jest
skills.use_when: An existing JavaScript or TypeScript implementation needs Jest unit tests, mocks or async assertions.
skills.do_not_use_when: The request is browser E2E, Python coverage, or production logic is still undefined.

skills.name: temporal-python-testing
skills.use_when: Temporal Python workflows need pytest time-skipping, activity isolation or replay determinism testing.
skills.do_not_use_when: The application does not use Temporal, or the request is ordinary pytest coverage without workflow history.

skills.name: csharp-mstest
skills.use_when: A C# project explicitly uses MSTest for unit or data-driven tests.
skills.do_not_use_when: The project uses pytest, Jest, Playwright or Spring/JUnit.

skills.name: github-actions-efficiency
skills.use_when: GitHub Actions workflow duration, caching or redundant CI work needs optimization.
skills.do_not_use_when: The immediate gap is a test procedure, browser scenario or local assertion.

skills.name: breakdown-test
skills.use_when: An existing broad test must be decomposed into smaller focused test cases.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is to discover missing coverage, explore a browser or choose a testing framework.

skills.name: playwright-generate-test
skills.use_when: A supplied browser scenario must be explored step by step before emitting a passing Playwright TypeScript test.
skills.do_not_use_when: The request is unit testing, coverage-only work, or no browser scenario is provided.

skills.name: scoutqa-test
skills.use_when: A web application needs exploratory QA, accessibility auditing or user-flow verification.
skills.do_not_use_when: The request is a deterministic unit test, code coverage report or non-browser build failure.

skills.name: spring-boot-testing
skills.use_when: A Spring Boot application needs the narrowest appropriate JUnit test slice and meaningful assertions.
skills.do_not_use_when: The project is Python or TypeScript, or the failure is solely CI infrastructure.

skills.name: playwright-explore-website
skills.use_when: A site must be interactively explored and documented without yet generating a durable E2E test.
skills.do_not_use_when: The scenario and desired artifact are already a Playwright test file or a unit test.

skills.name: webapp-testing
skills.use_when: A general web application test plan or interaction smoke test is requested.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task requires a specific pytest, Jest, Spring or frozen Playwright procedure.

skills.name: react19-test-patterns
skills.use_when: React 19 component behavior needs framework-specific test patterns.
skills.do_not_use_when: The target is a non-React Jest library, Python package or browser journey.

skills.name: unit-test-vue-pinia
skills.use_when: Vue code with Pinia stores needs focused unit tests.
skills.do_not_use_when: The project uses Jest without Vue, Playwright E2E, pytest or Spring Boot.

skills.name: azure-deployment-preflight
skills.use_when: An Azure deployment needs subscription, resource and configuration preflight checks.
skills.do_not_use_when: The failure is a local test, coverage gap or browser flow.

skills.name: creating-oracle-to-postgres-migration-integration-tests
skills.use_when: Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration integration tests must be implemented.
skills.do_not_use_when: No database migration exists, or the task is unit coverage or browser E2E.

skills.name: planning-oracle-to-postgres-migration-integration-testing
skills.use_when: An Oracle-to-PostgreSQL integration testing migration plan is needed before implementation.
skills.do_not_use_when: The task is a current test failure, ordinary coverage work or browser exploration.
